predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Eibar vs Burgos: Expected Goals (xG), Lineup Shifts & Match Analysis
predictions.coreRecommendation: Model probabilities and venue splits point toward Eibar securing at least a point at Ipurua in a competitive match where both attacks find the net.
possibilityAssessment: Eibar holds a 43.20% blended win probability anchored by superior midfield playmaking and ClubElo home advantage (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes align with a 2.81 combined lambda and open away defensive metrics for Burgos (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
A 1:1 draw remains a live contingency if Eibar's 61.1% big-chance waste rate persists against Burgos's set-piece threat (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Eibar's unbeaten Ipurua floor confronts Burgos's away defensive fragility and set-piece threat.

spf.comment: Covers both the leading 2:1 home-win script driven by Eibar's 85.7% home unbeaten rate and the 1:1 draw script triggered by Eibar's 61.1% big-chance waste rate, as a single home win omits Burgos's set-piece equalizer threat.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.81 combined lambda, 53.3% Over 2.5 model probability, Eibar's 1.44 xGA per game, and Burgos's 66.7% away Over 2.5 rate.

btts.comment: Eibar has scored in 100% of its home league matches against Burgos's 16.7% away clean-sheet rate, while Eibar's 28.6% home clean-sheet rate and flank absences allow Burgos's 28.6% set-piece attack to score.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Eibar's leading win probability with both teams scoring, while 1:1 captures the 12.3% top Poisson scoreline and Eibar's recent home draw pattern.

goals.comment: 3 goals matches the Over 2.5 and 2:1 primary projection given 2.81 combined lambda, while 2 goals covers the high-density 1:1 alternative.

bqc.comment: High first-half draw rates (42.9% home, 46.7% away) and Eibar's 54.5% second-half home goal share support Draw-Win first, with Draw-Draw covering Eibar's 66.7% home level-to-draw conversion.
